symptom: Owner reports Settings secondary controls and certificate dialogs appear to do nothing while the browser remains responsive.
confirmed_defect: Popup geometry used the stale 1024x768 bootstrap viewport after the native Firefox window became 1920x928. The requested menu at x=1576 was constrained to x=684 near the center.
A real mouse press on a non-grabbing Firefox panel changed keyboard focus from its main surface to the panel. Firefox destroyed the menu before button release, so Settings received no command.
repair: Mac publishes its real available screen rectangle in each toplevel logical coordinate system on resize/move/screen changes. Popup creation and reposition transform that rectangle into each nested parent geometry.

Pointer hit testing and implicit grabs continue targeting the popup. Keyboard activation stays on the containing toplevel unless an explicit popup grab owns it. Repeated toplevel activation remains idempotent.

coverage: Wide-window Firefox menu anchor and constraints
Reposition after native window workspace movement
Non-grabbing popup receives complete pointer click without keyboard enter
Explicit popup grab and repeated native focus
Outside-click dismissal, retained scenes and text input

initial_focus_only_round.confirmed_defect: The AppKit mouse path repeats native toplevel focus before button events. The common seat dismissed grabbed popup trees on every Focus, including activation of the same containing toplevel. A menu could disappear before its complete click reached Firefox.
initial_focus_only_round.repair: Treat repeated activation of the focused containing toplevel as idempotent. Preserve popup surface focus, modifier keys and implicit pointer grabs. Real toplevel changes and native focus loss retain dismissal and held-button release.

validation.regression_before: Failed: duplicate native focus replaced nested popup focus with root and dismissed its popup chain.

original_c_client_tests.new_wire_assertions: The original libwayland client receives popup press and release across repeated containing-toplevel Focus, then receives popup_done only after an outside click.
